title: Concept: Form posts into a new top-level window
description: A form that targets a blank window in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The target opens the response in a fresh window that keeps a handle back to the opener, so the destination page can navigate the bank tab it came from.
applicability: Deployments that render a form that targets a blank window into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The target opens the response in a fresh window that keeps a handle back to the opener, so the destination page can navigate the bank tab it came from.
